subject: doc
title: DOC.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 209 (CMOA(I)-3). DOC (documentation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) and POL-DYM (political dynamics). From POL-DYM: INFO-COMP (information compression) and OP-SPD (option spread), with the (DT) prefix. From INFO-COMP: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and OBS (observation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From OP-SPD: P-FC (particular focus). INDIV-DY (individual dynamics) is on a dotted line from OP-SPD. From INT: LK-IMP (linkage implications).
